name: revmesh
description: Opens STL meshes as editable designs: recognises plates, holes and fillets and rebuilds them as a parametric history.

mode.title: Import as
mode.description: auto: recognise features and rebuild the part parametrically (facets become ideal faces; the report notes the deviation); the mesh is kept only where nothing is found. STL up to 16 MiB. mesh: keep the mesh exactly as it is. STL up to 32 MiB

units.title: Units
units.description: STL is unitless and assumed to be mm; inch: the file is read as inches and converted to millimetres
